Jeu de forage : creuse à gauche, à droit: A drilling game: dig left, right or down through a 240-metre random mine, across five layers of earth and stone. Collect copper, iron, silver, gold, ruby, sapphire, then emerald, amethyst, diamond, mithril and starstone, more precious the deeper you go, and bring them back up to sell at the surface, where the tank refills by itself. Upgrade the tank, hold and drill (up to level 5) for hard rock and black rock; lava and running dry cost you your hold. Drill and cash register sounds, full screen.

Plus on descend, plus les minerais valen: The deeper you go, the more ores are worth: copper, iron, silver, gold, ruby, sapphire, then below 90 m emerald, amethyst, diamond, mithril and starstone. Hard rock needs a better drill, black rock (below 100 m) a level 3 drill at least; lava sends you back to the surface and loses your hold.
